newsitem.title: INDIA: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA WIN TOSS, TO BAT AGAINST INDIA.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA WIN TOSS, TO BAT AGAINST INDIA.

text.p: Australia's captain Mark Taylor won the toss and decided to bat against India in Monday's day-night match in the Titan Cup trianguler limited overs tournament.
India retained the team who lost the opening match of the competition to South Africa at Hyderabad last Thursday.
Australia made two changes to the side beaten by South Africa at Indore on Saturday, bringing in opener Michael Slater and pace bowler Damien Fleming instead of Ricky Ponting and Paul Reiffel.
India - Sachin Tendulkar (captain), Sujith Somasundar, Rahul Dravid, Mohammad Azharuddin, Saurav Ganguly, Ajay Jadeja, Sunil Joshi, Nayan Mongia, Anil Kumble, Javagal Srinath, Venkatesh Prasad.
Australia - Michael Slater, Mark Taylor (captain), Mark Waugh, Steve Waugh, Stuart Law, Michael Bevan, Ian Healy, Brad Hogg, Jason Gillespie, Glenn McGrath, Damien Fleming.
